scope: Keep every successful batch, unchanged frozen inference for all first attempts; bounded Qwen recovery only. Resume all unfinished conditions; do not restart successful batches.

stages.description: Original attempt at frozen settings; historical failed-batch artifact counts as this attempt.
One final repair: ID/schema correction feedback at original settings for formatting failure; otherwise 16000 generation tokens and 2400-second request timeout, without feedback.

fixed: Temperature 0; original per-batch seed; original prompt/model/batch size/context. No sampled retries, dropped records or singleton fallback.
durability: Record attempt reservation before inference. Interrupted attempt consumes its slot. Persist successful response before publishing checkpoint; reuse it if publication was interrupted. Exhaustion stops condition as incomplete across resubmissions.
reporting: Mark recovered batches and record IDs; report recovery frequency and completion alongside IRR. Full failed responses and every attempt are stored under results/dev_check_1/recovery/. Original failure files remain untouched.

parameter_order_fix.scope: Prove identical unique parameter values and unchanged other runtime fields, then express runtime parameter metadata in the original checkpoint order. Retain observed text/hash and original capture; never modify checkpoints or inference settings.
